debug.description: Enable verbose debug logging. Only recommended for troubleshooting.

log_max_entries.description: Maximum number of rotated log files to retain. Set to 0 for unlimited retention.

num_workers.description: Number of worker threads to handle credential requests. Increase for high-throughput environments.

cred_ttl.description: Time-to-live (in seconds) for generated credentials. After this period, credentials expire and must be regenerated.

cred_cache_ttl.description: Time-to-live (in seconds) for cached credentials in the local credential cache.

peers.description: List of hostnames or IP addresses of other Munge servers in the cluster for cross-node credential validation.

restrict_clients.description: Optional UID/GID range restriction for clients (e.g., '1000-1999:1000-1999'). Leave blank for no restriction.

bind_addr.description: IP address (IPv4 or IPv6) or hostname to bind the daemon to. Use '127.0.0.1' for localhost-only.

port.description: TCP port to listen on for network-based credential validation. Only used when SSL or network mode is enabled.

ssl_enabled.description: Enable TLS encryption for inter-node communication. Requires valid certificates.

ssl_cert.description: Path to the server's TLS certificate file (PEM format).

ssl_key.description: Path to the server's TLS private key file (PEM format).

ssl_ca_cert.description: Path to the CA certificate bundle (PEM format) used to verify peer certificates.

ssl_strict_hostname.description: Enforce strict hostname verification against certificate SANs/Subject CN. Recommended for production with SSL.

key_rotation_enabled.description: Automatically rotate the shared secret key on a schedule. Enables secure key lifecycle management.

key_rotation_interval.description: Interval (in seconds) between key rotations when key rotation is enabled.

key_path.description: Path to the symmetric secret key file (binary format). Must be readable only by the munge user (mode 0400).

socket_mode.description: Unix socket permissions in octal notation. Restrict to 0700 (owner only) for security.

socket_path.description: Path to the Unix domain socket used for local inter-process communication.
